from.place: Effective descent of lattice image classes

title: Effective descent of lattice image classes
statement: Let X be a scheme, J its pro-etale topology, R and S sheaves of commutative rings on J, a : R → S a ring-sheaf morphism, and L an S-module sheaf. An integral lattice pair on U consists of a finite locally free R|U-module P and a specified isomorphism S|U ⊗ P ≅ L|U, with the sheafified tensor product. Suppose the coefficient map is injective on every slice test object, r covers U, and x is a compatible family of represented lattice image families on r. There exists a lattice pair P on U such that for every f : V → U belonging to r and every T over V, the embedded image of P on T → V → U equals x(f)(T). [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-descent-data, lem-weil-pbc-lattice-glued-rationalization-isIso].

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; Descent and an exact presentation of lattice classes

proof.text: Take the constructed compatible-tuple module, its finite local freeness and rationalization isomorphism. The unit formula expresses its embedded image through the local tuple isomorphism. Surjectivity of that isomorphism identifies the range with the prescribed local image.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_latticePair_of_compatible_classes
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {R S : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : R ⟶ S)
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj S))
    (ha : ∀ (U : X.ProEt) T,
      Function.Injective (((latticeScalarMap a U).hom.app T).hom))
    (U : X.ProEt) (r : Sieve U) (hr : r ∈ (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) U)
    (x : Presieve.FamilyOfElements (latticeClassPresheaf a L) r.arrows)
    (hx : x.Compatible) :
    ∃ P : IntegralLatticePair a L U,
      ∀ (V : X.ProEt) (f : V ⟶ U) (hf : r f) (T : Over V),
        P.image (op ((Over.map f).obj T)) = (x f hf).down.val T
